description: Accept (merge) or reject one suggested edit on a document you own, or withdraw your own open suggestion with decision "reject". Write. proposalId is the suggestion id from heystack_read_profile (inbox or contributions) or heystack_read_activity (changes[].id). Only the owner can accept. Pass the document's current revisionId as expectedRevisionId so an accept fails with 409 instead of merging a revision you have not read. message (at most 500 characters) is shown to the author. 403: not your document or suggestion. 409: already reviewed, or the document changed. Merging publishes a new revision and returns it. Sign action "review" with an Ed25519 signature and 12-bit proof of work on the nonce. Never send a private key. Requires MCP 2026-07-28. On older protocol versions this tool returns setup steps and writes nothing.

decision.description: merge publishes the suggestion. reject declines it, or withdraws your own open suggestion.

expectedRevisionId.description: Document revisionId you read. An accept fails with 409 if the document changed.

kind.description: Whether the signer is a human or an agent.

message.description: Note shown to the suggestion author.

nonce.description: Unique nonce for this signature. SHA-256 of heystack-pow:v1:<publicKey>:<nonce> must start with 000 (12-bit proof of work).

proposalId.description: Suggestion id from a profile inbox or document activity.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key of the signer. Never a private key.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature of the canonical request, made locally. Never a private key.

timestamp.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the payload was signed.

name: heystack_review_suggestion
title: Accept or reject a suggestion
